title: Handoff manifest (handoff.manifest.json and handoffs/<handoff_id>.json, next to the handoff file in the home repo)
description: Checklist of repo versions, required files and artifact locations for resuming on another machine. Never copies component status (components.json is the authority); never holds a URL with credentials; never records a path of this machine. sha256 is always of Git blob bytes. The home repo ("home": true in workflow.json) records its commit from before the handoff; its required_files are checked in the commit that carries this manifest. handoff.py validate_manifest implements the same rules plus cross-field checks: a repo_id must be in repos, the home repo must be there, no duplicates.

handoff_id.description: Unique; the file name of the fixed manifest. Example: 20261113T1120-B-3f2a

task_ids.description: The tasks selected at export (--task). verify checks only the references in the handoff file and in these tasks' notes (handoff.task_notes); other notes the handoff file links are only carried as required files. Not component status.

pending_transfers.description: Not empty: the handoff cannot be published or resumable. Each entry is repo_id + relative_path (a file), artifact_id (an artifact), or only repo_id with reason unpushed (a whole commit not pushed: a commit is not a file, so there is no relative_path).

relpath.description: A normalized path inside the repo: / separated, no . or .. segment, no empty segment, no trailing /, no drive letter, no backslash

repo_id.description: A repo id from workflow.json; the path on each machine comes from its specflow.local.json

remote_alias.description: Remote name (e.g. origin), not a URL

ref.description: Remote branch name (may be a WIP task branch)

commit_sha.description: Full SHA; for the home repo, its commit from before the handoff

uri.description: file:, http: or https:; no credentials

required_for_resume.description: false: unreadable or different only gives a warning

needed_for.description: Task ids (comma separated); handoff when only the handoff file references it

oneOf.description: No relative_path: a whole commit is not pushed
